settings.tab_content: Guaranteed 22KT purity gold certified by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS). Hallmarked with unique HUID identification numbers.

Hand-crafted individually in Jaipur by legacy craftsmen with generations of experience in jadau and meenakari enamelling.
Eligible for lifetime buyback or exchange at 100% current gold weight value at any of our flagship showrooms.
